title: Staff can find any ticket, donation or order across every Space on the admin Payments page

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-27 (project thread: Trace the House of Fates payment); audit /mnt/project-files/payments-audit/PAYMENTS-ORDERS-TICKETS-AUDIT-2026-11-27.md

detail:
Owner report 2026-11-27: a $44 ticket came through for House of Fates and neither the owner nor staff could find it ('When I look I can't find much either'). The admin Payments page was an on/off switch and the only cross-Space list was shop orders, so a ticket or a donation took a database query to find.

DONE 2026-11-27: the admin Payments page keeps its switch and gains Find a payment: every settled or refunded ticket, donation and shop order across every Space, newest first, each with the item, buyer, Space, Pacific time, status, amount, fee and Stripe payment id, a link to that Space's Orders tab and a link to the payment in Stripe. Search narrows by a payment id (pi_...), a guest's email or a buyer's name. lib/admin/payments-finder.ts reads the three tables; an unreadable source is named on the page so a partial list is never read as the whole one. Read-only. No migration, no new menu item.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
